shared_elements: upright slab/stela with carved relief on its face
registers or horizontal bands stacked vertically
repeated animal or creature heads in a row
low-relief carving with raised outlined forms against a flat ground
justification: Both are upright carved slabs whose faces are divided into stacked horizontal registers containing repeated creature forms, and both use flat low relief with raised outlined shapes on a plain ground. But A depicts dense double columns of tightly packed, square-framed composite glyphic cartouches with human-like faces, while B shows sparse, widely spaced naturalistic profile animals (quadrupeds, a long-necked bird, arms and a fringe band) with no glyph blocks — the specific motifs and their relationships have little in common.
